prompts.title: Y2K 风格数码相机拍摄的年轻女性肖像
prompts.description: 一个高度详细的提示，用于生成一张 Y2K 偷拍数码相机摄影风格的年轻女性唯美肖像，要求面部与参考图 100% 一致，并指定姿势、妆容、服装、配饰、背景以及胶片颗粒和闪光灯等相机缺陷。
prompts.content:
Create an aesthetic portrait of a young woman in the style of Y2K candid digital camera photography, a cozy, aesthetic room setting similar to Tumblr or Pinterest photos, taken with an old digital camera with a flash to create the signature effect of 2000s digital camera photos.
The face must be 100% identical to the original reference face. Do not alter the facial shape, eyes, nose, lips, or facial features.
Pose:
She sits on the bed, holding a small silver-black camera forward slightly close to her face, as if preparing to take a photo. Her gaze is soft and slightly playful, her head slightly tilted and her shoulders relaxed. She smiles softly at the camera.

Makeup:
Soft, natural glam makeup with glowing, glass-like skin: flawless foundation, soft pink blush on the cheeks, subtle highlighter on the nose and cheekbones, thin, elongated black eyeliner, long, curly eyelashes, soft shimmering brown eyeshadow, neat, natural eyebrows, and a glossy, rosy pink lip that looks juicy and healthy.

Hair:
Black hair parted in a messy, fluffy style.

 Outfit:
A black tank top with thin straps, paired with an oversized cream hoodie that zips up to her chest and opens at one shoulder to reveal her black tank top.
A pair of thick, casual cream pants (not jogger pants) with no elastic at the bottom.

Accessories:
Transparent, cat-eye style glasses with black handles.
A small gold necklace with a minimalist pendant.

Background:
Aesthetic bedroom with a white bed sheet, no backrest, and white pillows and bolsters near the wall.
The white walls are covered with movie posters and vintage aesthetic posters from the 80s.

Lighting:
Direct camera flash, like a digital camera photo, provides bright highlights on the face and soft shadows behind.

Camera Imperfections:
Moderate film grain, slight digital noise, slight chromatic aberration, fine vignette, reddish light leak in the corners of the frame, and slightly soft focus, typical of older digital cameras.
prompts.translatedContent:
创作一张年轻女性的唯美肖像，风格为 Y2K 偷拍数码相机摄影，置身于温馨、唯美的房间，类似 Tumblr 或 Pinterest 上的照片，使用老式数码相机拍摄，并使用闪光灯营造出 2000 年代数码相机照片的标志性效果。
面部必须与原始参考面部 100% 一致。请勿改变面部形状、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇或面部特征。
姿势：
她坐在床上，手持一个银黑色的小相机，稍微靠近脸部，仿佛正准备拍照。她的目光柔和而略带俏皮，头部微微倾斜，肩膀放松。她对着镜头轻轻微笑。

妆容：
柔和、自然的魅力妆容，肌肤光泽如玻璃般：无瑕的粉底，脸颊上涂抹柔和的粉色腮红，鼻梁和颧骨处有微妙的高光，细长黑色眼线，卷翘的睫毛，柔和闪烁的棕色眼影，整洁自然的眉毛，以及水润健康的玫瑰粉色唇彩。

发型：
黑色头发，凌乱蓬松的分发。

服装：
一件黑色细肩带背心，搭配一件超大款米色连帽衫，拉链拉至胸部，一侧肩膀敞开，露出黑色背心。
一条厚实、休闲的米色长裤（非慢跑裤），裤脚无松紧带。

配饰：
透明猫眼式眼镜，黑色镜腿。
一条带有简约吊坠的小金项链。

背景：
唯美的卧室，白色床单，无床头板，靠墙放置白色枕头和长枕。
白墙上贴满了电影海报和 80 年代复古唯美海报。

灯光：
直射相机闪光灯，如同数码相机照片，在面部提供明亮的高光，并在其后方产生柔和的阴影。

相机瑕疵：
适度的胶片颗粒感、轻微的数码噪点、轻微的色差、精细的暗角、画面角落的微红色漏光，以及略微柔和的焦点，这些都是老式数码相机的典型特征。

prompts.title: 高端风格化数字绘画肖像提示词
prompts.description: 为 Nano Banana Pro 创建一张高端风格化数字绘画/插画海报人像的提示，要求人脸与上传的参考照片 100% 相同。风格包括动感的蓝色和橙色飞溅颜料、复古报纸拼贴背景以及电影级高对比度照明。
prompts.content:
Create a high-end stylized digital painting / illustrated poster portrait of the same man. The face must remain 100% identical to the reference photo, preserve exact facial structure, proportions, skin tone, features, age, hairstyle, and identity. Do not modify or beautify the face.
Half-body or close-up framing, the man looking slightly upward with a calm, confident expression. Ultra-detailed face with realistic skin texture translated into a refined digital painting style (not cartoonish or exaggerated).
Add dynamic blue and orange paint splashes and expressive ink strokes around the portrait.
Background: vintage newspaper collage with subtle typography fragments and distressed paper textures, integrated cleanly.
Lighting: cinematic high-contrast with dramatic highlights and controlled shadows.
Color grading: vibrant blue–orange contrast.
Output: ultra-detailed 4K modern illustrated poster, sharp, clean, premium finish.
prompts.translatedContent:
创作一幅高端风格化的数字绘画/插画海报肖像，描绘同一位男士。脸部必须与参考照片 100% 相同，保留精确的面部结构、比例、肤色、特征、年龄、发型和身份。请勿修改或美化脸部。

半身或特写构图，男士略微向上看，表情平静自信。面部超细节，逼真的皮肤纹理以精致的数字绘画风格呈现（非卡通或夸张）。

在肖像周围添加动态的蓝色和橙色飞溅颜料以及富有表现力的墨迹笔触。

背景：复古报纸拼贴画，带有微妙的排版碎片和做旧的纸张纹理，干净地融合在一起。

光照：电影级高对比度，具有戏剧性的高光和受控的阴影。

色彩分级：鲜明的蓝橙对比。

输出：超细节 4K 现代插画海报，锐利、干净、高端质感。

prompts.title: 鲜艳扁平插画风格的花卉与形状图案
prompts.description: 一个用于生成生动、扁平插画的提示，插画中包含重复、密集排列的程式化花朵和几何形状图案，采用大胆的原色，让人联想到中世纪现代设计或民间艺术。
prompts.content: A vibrant, flat illustration features a repeating pattern of stylized flowers and geometric shapes on a cream background. The composition is densely packed with various floral motifs in bold, primary colors like orange, blue, pink, yellow, and purple, interspersed with black and green elements. The flowers vary in design, from simple, rounded petals to more intricate, abstract forms. Some have distinct centers, while others are solid colors. Geometric shapes, such as diamonds, triangles, and semi-circles, are strategically placed throughout the pattern, adding a graphic quality.
